spec.name: proportionate-acceptance
spec.intent:
Census @15d0a621 (design at 15d0a621, working tree clean); every path is repo-relative on the plan's line. A line number or count cited here is a measurement at that commit: re-derive it if its path changed since. Realize the amended `planner role` (amended at 2026-09-30T13:58, cause note 'the loop is slow'): each unit's acceptance proves what that unit changes and no more; a proof costlier than the change, such as a live multi-model run for a wording edit, is a defect of the plan, not diligence. The rest of the gloss was realized by unit planner-position of plan corrected-shards and stands at census.
AT CENSUS. The planner's role sign (the `planner` string in packages/canon/src/dimensions/role/planner.ts) reserves census, decompose, realizes, sequence, bind, record, close, rectify or rebuild and reconcile, and says nothing of acceptance: `grep -c accept` on the file prints 0. The plan skill the planner composes holds acceptance as mechanical and able to fail (packages/canon/src/skills/plan/skill.ts) and sits 2 characters under Claude's 10,000-character per-hook cap (packages/canon/test/skill-hook-cap.test.ts prints `plan 9998`), so the law does not go there. The observed cost the amendment answers: units took 15 to 35 minutes end to end, mostly proving more than they changed (cold reads on two models, live smokes, size caps, verb-fidelity checks on wording edits).
CHANGE. (1) The role sign states the law in its own notation, as its own line or inside decompose: accept(unit) bounded to what the unit changes, and a proof costlier than the change a defect of the plan, not diligence. The comment above the sign says why, in a sentence or two. Declare no symbol that another cell declares differently. (2) .changeset/planner-proportionate-acceptance.md (@cratylus/canon patch). Nothing else changes: the planner agent's description and archetype, the role cell in packages/canon/src/roles/planner.ts and the plan skill stay as they are.
accept: After `pnpm build`, T=$(mktemp -d); `pnpm exec cratylus project --harness claude --out $T` exits 0, and the lines of $T/agents/planner.md from `## Role` up to the next `## ` heading contain `accept` and `defect` (census: neither).

`pnpm --filter @cratylus/canon exec vitest run test/reader-density.test.ts test/symbol-altitude.test.ts test/symbol-probe-gate.test.ts test/symbols.test.ts test/formal-block-self-sufficiency.test.ts test/structural-parsimony.test.ts test/skill-hook-cap.test.ts` exits 0, and skill-hook-cap still prints `plan 9998`.
